'''Carbon-nanofilament armor''', or '''CNF armor''', was a type of [[Hull/Legends|hull]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] equipped in the [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser]]s of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The CNF-armored cruisers were deployed during the [[Battle of Mindor]] against the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
